neighbours.label: The first digit of a second multi-digit number paired with an earlier one (11 or 12, CM-721 / CM-722, 0x01 / 0x02, 11 by 17), vs single-digit pairs and lists
fire: Most children lose their last baby tooth at age 12 or 13.

Standard tabloid paper measures 11 by 17 inches.
The protocol uses flag 0x04 for reads and 0x08 for writes.
The bus leaves at 10 and again at 11 every morning.
Chromosomes 14 and 15 were both affected in the sample.
Rooms 214 and 215 are reserved for the visiting team.
Players aged 16 or 17 may join the junior squad.
quiet: Most children lose their first baby tooth at age 6 or so.
The shop stocks three sizes of filter: small, medium and large.
Standard letter paper is a little shorter than legal paper.
The protocol uses one flag for reads and another for writes.
The bus leaves at 8 and again at 9 every morning.
Chromosomes in the sample were all intact and normal.
Rooms on the top floor are reserved for the visiting team.
Players aged 6 or 7 may join the mini squad.

predictions: Paired multi-digit numbers 0.5-0.9; single-digit pairs and lists under 0.1.
notes: Card: peaks on digits like '2' in '21 or 22', '1' in '11 by 17', '0' in 0x02. Probe: 11 or 12 0.903, CM-722 0.831, 11 by 17 0.747, 0x02 0.727, 11 and 1 0.516, '12 eggs and 2' 0.405; single-digit 'at 3 and ends around 5' 0.011, 'Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4' 0.057.
